methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: AI Ready Roanoke evaluates use for new technology in Roanoke Valley - Roanoke Times
signals.signal_reading: A regional collaborative initiative to evaluate and deploy AI across the Roanoke Valley signals distributed capacity-building through local networks, potentially creating replicable models for mid-sized metros outside NoVA's gravity well.

signals.title: News Flash Archive - NPD E911 Division implements Artificial Intelligence (AI) system on non-emergency lines - City of Norfolk (.gov)
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk's deployment of off-the-shelf AI for E911 non-emergency lines demonstrates shallow but pragmatic platform adoption in government services—broad distribution without requiring deep technical capability development.

signals.title: Warner, Anthropic launch AI pilot to help Hampton Roads military families find local resources - The Legacy Newspaper
signals.signal_reading: Senator Warner partnering with Anthropic to pilot AI for military families concentrates cutting-edge capability in Hampton Roads' defense corridor, leveraging existing institutional infrastructure rather than distributing AI fluency broadly.

signals.title: Problems with AI use in Roanoke County schools: It’s not the students - WFIR News
signals.signal_reading: Problems with AI use in Roanoke County schools—apparently by staff, not students—reveals shallow understanding even where technology is present, signaling adoption without meaningful capability development in educational institutions.

signals.title: ODU, CHKD want to map hotspots of childhood asthma in Hampton Roads with AI - WHRO
signals.signal_reading: ODU and CHKD's collaborative AI research mapping childhood asthma concentrates advanced technical capability within academic-medical partnerships, deepening expertise in metro hubs while leaving rural health systems without similar analytical infrastructure.
